message.glt.role.hint: Press H to choose whether you play as Chito or Yuuri.
screen.glt.role.title: Who are you?
screen.glt.role.together: Together: stay close and you both keep warmer.
role.glt.chito.perk1: Drives the Kettenkrad faster (+1 block per second)
role.glt.yuuri.con2: Slow to speed up and steer the Kettenkrad
message.glt.camp.no_room: No room for a campfire on this side.
item.glt.old_note.tooltip: Writing from the old world. Chito can read it.
message.glt.tank.chocolate_found: Yuuri found a chocolate ration hidden inside the tank!
message.glt.tank.rattle: Something rattles somewhere inside... Yuuri might find it.
message.glt.note.scribbles: Just scribbles. Maybe Chito can read it.
message.glt.beer.giggle: Everything is spinning... and somehow it's very funny.
note.glt.old_note.0: "Gone to the upper level to look for work. Back before the snow. - K."
note.glt.old_note.1: "Ration day is moved to the third bell. Bring your own container."
note.glt.old_note.2: "The heating in block 7 will be off until further notice. Stay together."
note.glt.old_note.3: "To whoever finds this: the elevator on the east side still works if you give it fuel."
note.glt.old_note.4: "We buried the cat under the big pipe. It liked the warm spot there."
note.glt.old_note.5: "Shopping list: bread, candles, batteries, something sweet for Mina."
note.glt.old_note.6: "I counted the stars tonight. I gave up at four hundred."
note.glt.old_note.7: "Notice: all citizens must report to the lower levels. Do not use the main road."
note.glt.old_note.8: "The fish in the old plant are still alive. The machine still feeds them. Nobody knows who built it."
note.glt.old_note.9: "Happy birthday. Sorry the cake is just a ration bar with a candle on it."
note.glt.old_note.10: "If the war ever ends, let's climb to the top and see what's up there."
note.glt.old_note.11: "Closed. The owner has gone to look for his family."
note.glt.old_note.12: "Remember: never drink the water from the red pipes. The grey ones are warm and safe."
note.glt.old_note.13: "Tank crews: hand in all chocolate rations at the depot. (Nobody ever does.)"
note.glt.old_note.14: "I wrote this so someone would know we were here."
note.glt.old_note.15: "The radio played music again tonight. Nobody knows where it comes from."
hud.glt.kettenkrad.out_of_fuel: Out of fuel. Yuuri can push it (W).
message.glt.kettenkrad.broken: The Kettenkrad broke down. Chito can fix it with Scrap Parts.
message.glt.kettenkrad.cant_repair: Yuuri has no idea how this works. Chito can fix it.
message.glt.bedroll.no_room: No room for the bedroll here.
message.glt.bedroll.cant_sleep_here: This is no place to sleep.
message.glt.bedroll.slept_home: Slept next to the Kettenkrad. Warm and rested.
item.glt.chitos_journal.tooltip: The story of our trip. Right-click to read.
screen.glt.journal.title: Chito's Journal
screen.glt.journal.empty: Nothing written yet. Let's go see what's out there.
message.glt.journal.new_entry: ✎ Chito wrote something in the journal.
message.glt.kettenkrad.out_of_fuel: The engine sputters and stops. Out of fuel.
message.glt.burn.warm: The fire flares up. Warm, for a moment.
message.glt.burn.journal_warning: The journal's edges curl in the heat... Throw it in again to really burn it.
message.glt.burn.journal_gone: Chito's journal burned. Everything written in it is gone.
journal.glt.ration: We split a ration bar. It tastes like nothing, but it's food.
journal.glt.chocolate: Chocolate. I'd forgotten anything could taste that sweet.
journal.glt.fish: Canned fish. Yuu ate hers in about three bites.
journal.glt.soup: Hot soup on a cold night. My fingers finally stopped hurting.
journal.glt.beer: We found something called beer. Everything spun and we couldn't stop laughing. I don't remember falling asleep.
journal.glt.tank_chocolate: Yuu found chocolate inside a tank. It was really sweet.
journal.glt.camp: We made camp next to the Kettenkrad. The fire crackled for a long time.
journal.glt.sleep_home: Slept beside the Kettenkrad. With the two of us and the blanket, it was almost warm.
journal.glt.out_of_fuel: The Kettenkrad ran out of fuel. Now we walk, or Yuu pushes.
journal.glt.pushing: Yuu pushed the Kettenkrad the whole way. She says she's fine. She's lying.
journal.glt.breakdown: Something inside the Kettenkrad went crunch. It won't move.
journal.glt.repair: I fixed the Kettenkrad with some scrap. It still rattles, but it runs.
journal.glt.snow: It started snowing. Everything went quiet.
journal.glt.freezing: It was so cold today I couldn't feel my feet. We need to find warmth.
journal.glt.huddle: Too cold to sleep alone. Yuu is warm, at least.
journal.glt.stars: We lay back and looked up. There were more stars than I could ever count.
journal.glt.high_place: We're so high up the whole city looks small.
journal.glt.old_note: I found a note someone left a long time ago. I wonder what happened to them.
journal.glt.burn_book: We burned a book to stay warm. I tried not to think about what was written in it.
journal.glt.journal_burned: Yuu burned my journal to keep us warm. Everything I wrote is gone. ...It's okay. We'll make new memories.
role.glt.chito.perk3: Reads old notes, keeps the journal, repairs the Kettenkrad
role.glt.chito.perk4: Finds more notes, maps and parts in chests
role.glt.yuuri.perk4: Finds hidden chocolate and more food in chests
role.glt.yuuri.perk5: Can push the Kettenkrad when the fuel runs out
item.glt.yuuris_rifle.tooltip: Right-click to fire. Uses Rifle Cartridges. Sneak to steady your aim.
item.glt.nuko.tooltip: Hold it to hear the radio. Right-click the ground to put it down.
message.glt.rifle.driving: Both hands are on the handlebars.
journal.glt.rifle: Yuu fired the rifle. The sound echoed off every wall in the city for a long time.
journal.glt.nuko: A little white creature ate one of Yuu's bullets. Then it followed us. We're calling it Nuko.
journal.glt.nuko_radio: When we hold Nuko, music comes out of it, like an old radio. We listened for a long time.
role.glt.yuuri.perk6: A good shot with the rifle, even from the back seat
item.glt.camera.tooltip: Right-click to take a photo. Film left: %s
item.glt.chitos_coat.washed: Freshly washed: dry and extra warm
message.glt.camera.no_film: Out of film. Reload it with paper in an anvil.
message.glt.bath.coat_washed: The coat is clean. It'll be dry and warm for a while.
message.glt.factory.yuuri: Yuuri presses buttons at random. Nothing happens. Maybe Chito knows how it works.
message.glt.statue.offering: You leave it as an offering. You feel a little lucky.
message.glt.cairn.done: The pile is complete. It feels like good luck.
journal.glt.bath: We found a broken pipe pouring out hot water and took a bath. We stayed in until our fingers wrinkled.
journal.glt.rain_music: It rained on the cans and the helmet, and each one made a different sound. It was almost a song.
journal.glt.food_factory: An old machine pressed potatoes and sugar into ration bars. So that's where they come from.
journal.glt.offering: We left some food for a stone statue. Yuu wanted to eat it back afterwards. I said no.
journal.glt.cairn: We stacked a stone on the little pile. Somebody else did the same, a long time ago.
journal.glt.street_lamps: The street lamps came on by themselves when it got dark. Someone made them to keep working.
journal.glt.photo: We took a photo together. Now this moment won't disappear.
message.glt.elevator.dead: The console is dark. It isn't connected to anything.
message.glt.elevator.yuuri: Yuuri pushes every button. Nothing happens. Better ask Chito.
message.glt.elevator.no_fuel: The motor needs power. Bring a Fuel Canister.
message.glt.elevator.up: The motor coughs to life. Going up...
message.glt.elevator.down: The brakes let go. Going down...
message.glt.sign.scribbles: Old letters. Yuuri can't read them. They look like little bugs.
message.glt.city.top_floor: Floor %s. There's nothing above us anymore.
journal.glt.elevator: We found an elevator as big as a house, and it still worked. We rode it up with the Kettenkrad and watched the floor fall away.
journal.glt.new_floor: We climbed to a new floor. It's colder up here, and quieter. Yuuri says it smells like snow.
journal.glt.old_sign: I read an old sign today. The people who wrote it must have walked these streets every day.
sign.glt.old_sign.0: LEVEL TRANSIT: elevators run every hour. Please have your pass ready.
sign.glt.old_sign.1: Residential block 7. Quiet hours after the evening bell.
sign.glt.old_sign.2: CAUTION: falling debris. Use the covered walkway.
sign.glt.old_sign.3: Public bath, hot water from the plant. Two coins.
sign.glt.old_sign.4: Ration office. One packet per person per day. No exceptions.
sign.glt.old_sign.5: To the upper levels. Pedestrians use the ramp tower.
sign.glt.old_sign.6: Fish farm. Staff only. Do not feed the fish.
sign.glt.old_sign.7: Shelter. In an emergency, go down, not up.
sign.glt.old_sign.8: Heat plant 3. Do not touch the pipes.
sign.glt.old_sign.9: Lost and found. Ask at the counter.
sign.glt.old_sign.10: The last train left from here. There will be no more.
sign.glt.old_sign.11: Welcome to the city. We hope you stay.
